title: FINAL: independent ADR-0020 re-audit of the candidate SRD pack
description:
Perform the independent max-effort audit of the candidate after bounded automated gates
pass and before formal re-freeze. Adversarially inspect source fidelity/provenance,
discovery-supporting relationships, adjudication boundaries, selected capability correctness,
and state-integrity/runtime ownership as separate concerns. Automated green is entry evidence,
not universal completeness proof.
design:
2026-11-01 DESIGN (Claude Captain). The audit target is the exact candidate: main at the merge commit of PR #697 (the pack bytes are those of fcc76eae; #697 changes only tooling). The independent auditor is GPT-6.1-Sol, read-only, high effort. It is independent of the implementers (Sonnet, Luna and the Captain). Five lanes, each a child bead. At most 2 run concurrently. Each lane reports findings in its own bead notes, and the Captain consolidates them.
L1 SOURCE FIDELITY and PROVENANCE: every record kind against the vendored PDF. Coverage:
 - attack each registry finding class beyond its original example (recurrence hunt);
 - truthful locators and provenance; no compiler-authored content carrying source provenance or the licence (bar 1, 2, 7);
 - reproducibility (verify:dnd5e-srd-pack).
L2 DISCOVERY: relationship declarations and their resolution, rule-awareness and discovery expansion, and context packets. Disclosed limits (19.3.5) are reported as limits; any undisclosed discovery defect is reported (bar 9).
L3 ADJUDICATION SUPPORT and SEMANTIC MODELLING: executionReadiness clause classification (green, engine-pending, adjudicated-by-design); model-facing tool and record descriptions against source and the real tool contracts; the DM-default-interpreter boundary; no unsupported completeness claim in any in-band artifact (bar 4).
L4 DETERMINISTIC CAPABILITY CORRECTNESS: every deterministic capability inventory and ledger entry in force. It checks that each one:
 - declares its operation, inputs, exclusions and residual interpretation truthfully;
 - fails closed on unrecognized input;
 - has evidence that exercises it (bar 6).
L5 STATE INTEGRITY and RUNTIME OWNERSHIP: every runtime gate that can block or perform a mutation has a live owner and a regression test (bar 8); migrations, state transitions and idempotency; end-to-end playable validation within the tests.
Each finding records: lane; BLOCKER or NON-BLOCKER; concrete evidence (record key or file:line, and source page); the registry alias if it recurs a known class; and a suggested owner. Each lane also records explicit LIMITS: what it did not or could not enumerate. A clean lane means no blocker was found, not completeness.
After the lanes, the Captain writes docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/<date>-o9bd-16-independent-candidate-audit.md. It gives per-dimension results, findings with dispositions or owning beads, limits and non-claims. Blockers get beads that block eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4.
acceptance_criteria:
- Independent audit is performed against the exact candidate and current authority.
- Source fidelity, discovery, adjudication support, deterministic capability, and state integrity are reported separately.
- Known defect classes are attacked beyond original examples; any recurrence/new substantive defect blocks re-freeze and receives ownership.
- Unknown/unrecognized/unenumerable scope is reported as a limit, not a green result.
- A clean result means no blocker was found against the ADR-0020 truthfulness bar, not universal completeness.
notes:
2026-07-08 ADR 0017 adjustment: The final max-effort audit should use the compiler guide's dimensions explicitly: reproducibility, source completeness, structural fidelity, semantic modeling, runtime ownership/support, and end-to-end playable validation. Report them separately instead of collapsing them into a single 'represented somewhere' result.

AFTER regeneration and re-freeze. That edge is removed. The corrected closure
chain audits the CANDIDATE bundle BEFORE the formal re-freeze:

  19.6.1 corpus migration -> 19.6.2 regression/finding closure
  -> 19.6.3 candidate bundle + automated no-repeat gates
  -> eshyra-o9bd.16 (THIS BEAD) independent max-effort re-audit

  -> eshyra-2zyy re-enable post-freeze thaw-note gating

SCOPE CHANGE: this bead now audits a candidate, pre-freeze artifact rather than a
frozen one. Its original description ("After ... the pack is regenerated/re-
frozen, perform a MAX-EFFORT re-audit") reflects the old order — read the
dependency graph, not that sentence, for sequencing. Everything else about the
max-effort standard stands.

This bead is deliberately NOT superseded by the new program: eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3
generates the candidate and passes automated gates, but independent review
belongs here.
